name: Qiu zhi Huiyi Qiwang
source:
This game is the prequel of the Memories Off Sorekara Inori route, which contains many scenes that were briefly mentioned in the main story, and shows them in detail in front of our eyes. Let us experience the slightly sad tenderness of Inori again~

(Source: Readme file in patch)
